A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 37-page versions of the same paper. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the main text and Appendices A–D.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original experiments, including Tiny ImageNet model-merging results and CIFAR-100 communication-scheduling results in Figures 1–2.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including the main performance curves and supplementary experiments in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 receives a limited pseudocode correction: the optimizer output becomes the t+1/2 iterate, and gossip averages these updated parameters instead of the t iterates. Appendix D already specified this update in v3, so this does not establish a change to the implemented method or experiments.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage remain unchanged, including the Tiny ImageNet and CIFAR-100 experiments and the heterogeneity and communication-topology scenarios in Appendix C.

E2.justification: The same federated-training and local-training comparators remain in the corresponding experiments. Figures C.1–C.2 retain FedAdamW and one-shot FedAdamW, with no comparator additions or removals.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation settings remain unchanged, including global test accuracy, data partitioning, agent counts, hyperparameters, and the 300 communication rounds with 100 local steps described in Appendix C.1.

E4.justification: The no-communication comparison in Figure 2c and the optimizer, topology, hyperparameter, initialization, heterogeneity, and final-gossip analyses in Appendix C are unchanged.

E5.justification: No run-count, seed, uncertainty-reporting, or significance-testing information changes. The statistical presentation of the experimental curves is identical.

E6.justification: Figures 1–2 and C.1–C.6 are visually identical across versions. Their plotted performance values, trends, and accompanying findings are unchanged, with no result entries added or removed.

T1.justification: The definitions, assumptions, convergence results, and Appendix D proofs are unchanged. Equations 9–10 receive typesetting adjustments without changes to their mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and concluding discussion retain the same claims about late communication, single global merging, persistent mergeability, and matching the convergence rate of parallel SGD.

C2.justification: The explanations involving progressive sharpening, consensus error, and loss-landscape geometry remain unchanged, as do the applicability discussion and vision-domain limitation in Appendix A.

D1.justification: The first-page blog hyperlink changes from a placeholder target to a specific article URL. Code links and the implementation, hardware, hyperparameter, and runtime disclosures in Appendix C.1 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B, and the reference list are unchanged. No cited works or substantive comparisons with prior decentralized-learning and model-merging research are added or removed.

P1.justification: Algorithm 1 introduces intermediate-step notation, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The prose, headings, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Localized mathematical typesetting and spacing change on pages 4 and 9. All figures and tables, including those in the appendices, retain identical content, design, and placement.

improvement.justification: v4 improves consistency by aligning Algorithm 1's averaging expression with the update already specified in Appendix D, and replaces the placeholder blog target with a specific address. These are limited clarity and access improvements. The pseudocode correction remains incomplete because communication line 3 still names the old iterate; the scientific evidence is unchanged.
